title: Daily Fleece Quiz App — Project Handover
description:
Quiz app for daily standup fun. Two questions per session: Q1 (knowledge, A/B/C) and Q2 (geography, select country on map). Both presented as uploaded photos (calendar page photo for Q1, location photo for Q2).

KEY DOCUMENTS:
- REQUIREMENTS.md — 9 use cases (UC-01 to UC-09) + 20 functional requirements
- CONTEXT.md — domain glossary (Session, Host, Player, Lobby, Voting, Answer, etc.)
- docs/adr/0001-0009 — Architecture Decision Records

DOMAIN SUMMARY:
- Host = first player to tap 'Start Quiz'; also plays as a regular player
- Session phases: Lobby → Active → Ended
- Two questions per session, Q1 then Q2, host controls pacing
- Voting: hidden until host closes it; host sees count only ('4/6 answered')
- Players can change answer while voting open; non-answering = 0 pts
- 1 pt per correct answer; host marks correct answer after closing voting
- Session locked after start (lobby-only joining)
- Running leaderboard, always accessible, one global project for now

STACK (decided):
- Monorepo: api/, backend/, frontend/
- Backend: Spring Boot + Java, Spring Modulith (2 modules: quiz + player)
- Frontend: Angular, NgRx Signal Store, Sheriff, Testing Library
- Datastores: MongoDB (primary + GridFS for photos) + Valkey (live session state)
- API: spec-first OpenAPI in api/openapi.yaml
- Deploy: 2 CF apps (nginx buildpack + java buildpack)
- Photo TTL: 28 days via MongoDB GridFS TTL index
- Auth: stub (name-based) now, company SSO (OIDC) later
- Mobile-first

DEFERRED:
- Real-time protocol (SSE vs WebSocket) — pending intranet network check
- Auth implementation details — pending company SSO specifics
- Project management / leaderboard reset — one global project for now

title: Domain model: MongoDB documents and Valkey session state

MongoDB documents: Session (including live state: phase, voting status, answer counts), Player, Answer, Photo (GridFS). Java entities for Spring Modulith quiz + player modules. title: UC-09: View Leaderboard
description: Cumulative standings for the current project, accessible at any time (not just after a session). Ranked list of all players with total points. Shown automatically after session results. One global project for now. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-09, FR-17, FR-18, FR-19.

title: UC-08: View Session Results
description: After session ends, all players see a results screen showing each player's points (0, 1, or 2) for the session. Screen then transitions to the Leaderboard. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-08, FR-16.

title: UC-07: Close Q2 Voting and Reveal Answer
description: Host closes Q2 voting. All country selections revealed. Host selects the correct country. App awards 1 point per correct answer. Session transitions to Ended phase. Session Results screen shown to all players. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-07, FR-16.

title: UC-06: Answer Geography Question (Q2)
description: Players see Q2 photo and a world map. Player selects a country on the map. Answer is hidden during voting; players can change selection while voting is open. Host sees answer count and Close Voting button. Same rules as Q1 voting. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-06, FR-20.

title: UC-05: Close Q1 Voting and Reveal Answer
description: Host closes Q1 voting. All answers are revealed. Host selects the correct answer (A/B/C). App awards 1 point per correct answer. Q2 is then presented to all players. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-05, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14.

title: UC-04: Answer Knowledge Question (Q1)
description: Players see Q1 photo and three answer buttons (A/B/C). Answers are hidden from all during voting. Players can change answer while voting is open. Host sees answer count (X/N answered) and a Close Voting button. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-04, FR-08, FR-09, FR-10, FR-11, FR-15.

title: UC-03: Start Session
description: Host taps Start Quiz in the Lobby. Session transitions from Lobby to Active phase. Session is locked (no new joins). Q1 is presented to all players. The first player to tap Start Quiz becomes the Host. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-03, FR-04, FR-05, FR-07.

title: UC-02: Join Lobby
description: Player opens the app, authenticates (stub auth for now), and enters the Lobby. Sees list of joined players. Lobby is only joinable before session starts — active sessions show a 'session in progress' message. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-02, FR-05, FR-06.

title: UC-01: Upload Photos
description: Host uploads two photos required to start a session (Q1 knowledge photo, Q2 geography photo). Photos stored in MongoDB GridFS with 28-day TTL. Start Quiz button becomes available only after both are uploaded. Photos can be replaced before session starts. See REQUIREMENTS.md UC-01 and FR-03.

title: Set up monorepo skeleton (api/, backend/, frontend/)

title: Decide real-time protocol: SSE vs WebSocket
description:
The quiz requires server-to-client push: question opens, voting closes, answer revealed, scores updated.

SSE + REST (recommended): Server pushes via long-lived HTTP stream. Clients send actions via REST. Simpler, fits OpenAPI contract cleanly.
WebSocket (STOMP): Full-duplex, Spring first-class support. More complex.

BLOCKED ON: Check company intranet restrictions — corporate proxies may block WebSockets or long-lived HTTP. Once known, pick one and write ADR-0007.

title: Write initial OpenAPI spec (api/openapi.yaml)
description: Spec-first. Endpoints needed: POST /sessions, POST /sessions/{id}/start, POST /sessions/{id}/join, POST /sessions/{id}/questions/{q}/answers, POST /sessions/{id}/questions/{q}/close, POST /sessions/{id}/questions/{q}/correct, GET /sessions/{id}/results, GET /leaderboard. Real-time events endpoint TBD (depends on protocol decision). Country = ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
close_reason: OpenAPI 3.0 spec written at api/openapi.yaml. Covers all REST endpoints, SSE events with oneOf discriminator, and RFC 9457 ProblemDetail errors. Real-time events endpoint stubbed pending df-lg7 protocol decision.
